basic_details.job_title: GPSC Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 16 Executive Engineer, Deputy Executive Engineer and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: Gujarat Public Service Commission (Gujarat Jaher Seva Aayog) is inviting online applications for 16 engineering posts under Advertisement Nos. 60/2026-27 to 65/2026-27. The posts are Executive Engineer (Construction) and Executive Engineer (Mechanical), Class-1, in the Gujarat Maritime Board; Deputy Executive Engineer (Civil), Assistant Engineer (Civil) and Assistant Engineer (Electrical), Class-2, in the Sports Authority of Gujarat; and Assistant Engineer (Electrical), Class-2, in the Gujarat Maritime Board. Assistant Engineer (Electrical), Class-2 (Sports Authority of Gujarat)

how_to_apply: Read the full advertisement for your post on https://gpsc.gujarat.gov.in or https://gpsc-ojas.gujarat.gov.in.
Apply online on https://gpsc-ojas.gujarat.gov.in between 6 November 2026 (13:00 hrs) and 20 November 2026 (11:59 pm).
Read the advertisement number and post name clearly and submit only one online application for each advertisement.
Upload your own photograph and signature while filling in the application.
After filling in all details, check them and then confirm the application.
Obtain the Confirmation Number within the given time; this is compulsory.
Download and save a copy of the confirmed application form, and check your details, photograph and signature on it.

The notice gives the fee payment route for unreserved (Bin Anamat) category candidates: by challan at a post office up to 21 November 2026 within that post office's office hours, and online on https://gpsc-ojas.gujarat.gov.in up to 11:59 pm. The fee amount is not specified in the notice.

The online application stays "Editable" until the closing date and time. To correct a mistake in a confirmed application, use the "Edit" option in the "Online Application" menu before the deadline; do not make a new application. No changes can be made after the online application time ends.
important_instructions: If a candidate's application or call letter shows someone else's photograph or signature, the candidate will not be allowed to sit in the examination. If a candidate makes more than one application, only the last confirmed application will be accepted; for unreserved candidates, the last confirmed application with the fee. The candidate alone is responsible for any failure to obtain the Confirmation Number in time. The website for online applications stays open only until 11:59 pm on 20 November 2026; the notice asks candidates to fill in and confirm the application early rather than wait for the last day. The full details - age, age relaxation, pay scale, fee, method of applying, general provisions, recruitment rules and recruitment (examination) rules - are on https://gpsc.gujarat.gov.in and https://gpsc-ojas.gujarat.gov.in.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: None of the posts is reserved for women, ex-servicemen or candidates with disabilities: the notice prints 0 in each of those columns for every post. The Commission has the unfettered right to change the number of posts, subject to the proposal of the department concerned.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice also fixes which certificates are accepted: Age proof: only the SSCE certificate showing the date of birth. No other document will be accepted. SEBC candidates: the Non-Creamy Layer Certificate (NCLC) only in Appendix-K - Appendix-4 (Gujarati). EWS candidates: the certificate only in the format prescribed by the Gujarat Government's Social Justice and Empowerment Department resolution No. EWS/122019/45903/A dated 25/01/2019 - Annexure-KH in English or Appendix-G in Gujarati. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, see the official notification on the GPSC website.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in GPSC Recruitment 2026 (Advt. 60 to 65/2026-27)?
faq.answer: There are 16 posts: 2 Executive Engineer posts, 4 Deputy Executive Engineer (Civil) posts and 10 Assistant Engineer posts (4 Civil and 6 Electrical).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 20 November 2026 at 11:59 pm; it opens on 6 November 2026 at 13:00 hrs.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required?
faq.answer: The short-form table lists BE/BTECH (Civil) for the Civil and Construction posts, BE/BTECH (Mech/Marine) for Executive Engineer (Mechanical), and BE/BTECH (Electrical) for the Assistant Engineer (Electrical) posts.

faq.question: Q4. Is experience required for these posts?
faq.answer: The notice's short-form table shows "None" under experience for all six posts.

faq.question: Q5. On which date will age be counted?
faq.answer: Age will be counted as on the last date of online application, 20 November 2026, and only the SSCE certificate showing the date of birth is accepted as age proof.

faq.question: Q6. How do unreserved candidates pay the application fee?
faq.answer: Unreserved candidates can pay by challan at a post office up to 21 November 2026 within office hours, or online on https://gpsc-ojas.gujarat.gov.in up to 11:59 pm.

faq.question: Q7. When is the GPSC preliminary test for these posts?
faq.answer: The proposed date of the Preliminary Test (General Studies) is 17 January 2027; the date of the examination of the relevant subject will be announced later.

faq.question: Q8. Can I correct my application after confirming it?
faq.answer: Yes, until 11:59 pm on 20 November 2026, through the "Edit" option in the "Online Application" menu; do not make a new application, and no changes are possible after the deadline.

faq.question: Q9. Are any posts reserved for women or ex-servicemen?
faq.answer: No. The notice shows 0 posts reserved for women, candidates with disabilities and ex-servicemen in all six advertisements.
